mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_GREAT_BAHAMUT (51), drawn out of the Bahamut's model (MONSTER_MODEL_BAHAMUT, Monster34.bmd). OpenMU Version075 Maps/Atlans.cs names breed 51 'Great Bahamut'. docs/atlans-port.md Part B 4.
mesh_from: Bahamut01's model a second time: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13775-13780, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_GREAT_BAHAMUT: OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_BAHAMUT); CreateCharacter(Key, MODEL_BAHAMUT, ...); Scale = 1.0f; Level = 1. The same body and sheets at full size, with the fins' soft alpha its model carries.
monster_from: Scale 1.0 against the Bahamut's 0.6. Level 1 adds, while it lives, a BITMAP_SMOKE + 1 within 32 units of it one reference frame in four (ZzzCharacter.cpp:6169-6176), the Budge Dragon's own dust; Play's breathing figures draw it (kGreatBahamutFigure).
sounds_from: The Bahamut's model's: SetMonsterSound(..., 130, 130, 131, 131, 130) in ZzzOpenData.cpp:3639-3643. Wired as greatbahamut_* in sounds.json, as bahamut_*.
